_doc: Config of overflow.py (capped-overflow test: experts that fit nowhere else genuinely live on the SSD). Same schema as scripts/placement-qual/arms.json for vars, engine, arms, variants, limits, so qual_cfg.load and qual_engine.Engine run it unchanged; capacity, tiers, sweep, gates, w7 and estimate are this harness's. {name} placeholders come from vars (override with --var name=value) plus {rundir}. The helper command and the KL thresholds are read from placement-qual/arms.json (one owner). Flags this file owns and the launcher's base config must NOT contain: --expert-cache, --expert-cache-device1, --expert-cache-device2, --resident-budget-gib, --max-context, --stats, --retier*, --adapt-* (the ladder arm gets its flags from install/_ladder.py). WHY each number is what it is: README.md section Design.

vars.gpu: UNSET: pass --var gpu=<CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES of the helper card: an index or a GPU UUID; a UUID identifies one machine, so it is never kept in the repo>
vars.rocm: UNSET: pass --var rocm=<the ROCm install dir>
vars.pack: UNSET: pass --var pack=<the model pack dir>
vars.forced_set: UNSET: pass --var forced_set=<the forced set JSON made by force_check.py gen>
vars.forced_cfg_R: UNSET: pass --var forced_cfg_R=<engine config JSON of the uncapped reference>
vars.forced_cfg_O1: UNSET: pass --var forced_cfg_O1=<engine config JSON of arm O1, with the capacity flags the dry run prints>
vars.forced_cfg_O2: UNSET: pass --var forced_cfg_O2=<engine config JSON of arm O2>
vars.forced_cfg_O3: UNSET: pass --var forced_cfg_O3=<engine config JSON of arm O3>
vars.forced_cfg_O3L: UNSET: pass --var forced_cfg_O3L=<engine config JSON of arm O3L, with the ladder flags and env of install/_ladder.py>

hooks_doc.ladder_extra_args: extra engine flags for the ladder arm (O3L) only, as one string split on spaces, for flags the installer's ladder set (install/_ladder.py, imported: one owner) does not carry. The ladder set already carries --adapt-every 64 --adapt-swaps 8; a value given here comes last and overrides. Empty = exactly the installer's set.
hooks_doc.unbuffered: empty = the engine chooses how the file tier reads. 1 sets STRATA_UNBUFFERED_LOAD=1 (O_DIRECT reads, which no page cache can serve) on every capped arm: the strictest variant of the same test, and a cross-check of the cgroup mechanism.
hooks_doc.disk: auto = the /proc/diskstats entry of the device the model file lives on. A name (for example nvme0n1p2) overrides it.
hooks_doc.allow_rotational: 0 = refuse a model on a spinning disk (the test is about SSD). 1 = run anyway.

R.label: uncapped reference (all experts on the cards, no file tier, no cgroup limit)

O1.label: main card only: small cache, small RAM budget, the rest on SSD

O2.label: O1 plus the helper card (second GPU)

O3.label: O2 plus a second helper process (static placement: two helper channels)
O3.note: SEABRAID_STRATA_SHM is a comma list, one channel per helper, position = card id (adapters/strata/wire/strata/seabraid/channel_names.hpp, patch 0017); --expert-cache-device1 and --expert-cache-device2 give each helper its slots. Both helper processes run on the {gpu}/{gpu2} card (the same card unless gpu2 is set), so their slots share that card's VRAM.

O3L.label: O3 plus the live ladder: SSD -> RAM -> helper2 -> helper1 -> main moves, flags and env from install/_ladder.py
O3L.note: differs from O3 by the ladder flags and env only (one variable). Its data gate also needs the adapter's 'placement move' lines: a move from the fallback rung onto a helper rung, a hop onto each helper rung, and no stale-epoch refusal.

capacity.note: ESTIMATE: experts_gib 47 is the owner's figure for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_S (48 layers x 512 experts); the engine's own startup lines are compared with it by the data gate. main_card_gib 24.0 and helper_card_gib 22.8 are the all-VRAM split in docs/DESIGN-LOG.md. ram_gib 6 stays inside the 15.13 GiB GTT ceiling noted there. engine_overhead_gib 8 is a guess to be replaced by the first run's memory.peak.

sweep.note: kept under the name 'sweep' because pay_measure reads cfg['sweep']. 3 counted rounds is enough for means and a spread, not for a significance claim: this harness proves the SSD was used and the output is right, it does not rank arms by speed.

estimate.note: ESTIMATE: none of these were measured by this harness; they bound the GPU window so the owner can book it. decode 1.5..30 tok/s spans heavy SSD overflow to a mostly-cached run; prefill 40..800 tok/s (a 3,500-token prompt touches nearly every expert, so it reads much of the SSD); load 180..480 s is payoff's guess. Replace with the shakedown's chain.tsv seconds.
